name: Pogány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pogány: a shield of blue and white with a tree and a well, with black and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed 1181 POGÁNY 1999.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pogány arms with mantling and scroll
